ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute cannot be decided on the record, so I am sending it to a human reviewer instead of picking a side.

The no-show fee under POL-NS-01 is chargeable only if all four conditions hold together. Two of them are confirmed by the trip record: the driver's 'arrived' event at 21:10:20 (condition (a)), and the trip terminated by the driver at 21:15:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding event (condition (d)). The other two depend entirely on the GPS trace, and there is no GPS trace. Condition (b) requires the gps_trace to place the car inside the pickup geofence (150 m at this TRANSPORT_HUB pin) at or before 21:10:20; condition (c) requires a continuous 300-second in-geofence dwell measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival marker. EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING - no payload, MISSING_ARTIFACT at BLOCKING severity, weight_multiplier 0.0 - and a missing artifact can carry no fact. The driver's own statement that 'the GPS export is unavailable' confirms the gap.

Because the artifact those two tests read is absent, conditions (b) and (c) are undecided - neither passed nor failed. An undecided limb supports neither the fee (which needs all four conditions to hold) nor a refund (which would need the geofence test to run and find no qualifying in-radius fix). The rider's other routes fail the same way: POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker), POL-NS-06 (dwell shortfall), POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) and POL-NS-04 (unanswered rider contact) each require a GPS fact this record does not contain. POL-NS-04 is closed on its own terms in any event: the driver replied 'I am here beside the sign' 15 seconds after the rider's 21:11:30 message, far inside the 120-second silence limb (b) allows, so it yields no refund regardless of the missing trace.

I have not used the chat log to bridge the gap. The driver's 'I am at the private-hire bay' and 'I am here beside the sign' are his own assertions inside the waiting window, and the rider's answer is that she could not see the car; where the GPS test admitted no reading at all, the chat is standing in for the test rather than corroborating it, so it neither lifts the confidence cap nor stops the missing trace being the sole evidence for the deciding fact. The counterparty statement carries no weight_multiplier and so enters neither side of the cap.

Two things are settled. First, the amount is correct: fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee of SGD 6.00 is exactly the GREATER of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule - the transport-hub dimension produces the figure - so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect and nothing to disturb; the charge is PENDING with SGD 0.00 refunded. Second, no behaviour-based trigger fires: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check requires, and 1 over 120 completed trips is 0.008, below the 0.08 rate limb, so both limbs fail and none is withheld; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and neither party's disputes_with_counterparty_90d exceeds 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire. I therefore reach no driver compensation under POL-NS-07, and I reject the argument that the charge should simply stand: NO_ACTION under POL-NS-07 describes the disposition of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which here it cannot be, the GPS being absent.

The deciding fact is carried only by an artifact at weight 0.0, so the ruling's confidence is capped at 0.0, below the 0.70 floor. The case escalates under POL-NS-09(a), and independently under POL-NS-09(e) because the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired. Escalation is terminal and replaces any money outcome: the SGD 6.00 is held - neither collected nor refunded - while review is pending. The specific question for the reviewer is whether the driver's GPS export for the 20:58-21:15 window can be produced; if it can, the geofence and effective-dwell tests under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 can be run and the fee will either stand or be refunded on the ordinary clauses. No finding is made against either party's honesty.
